description: [LocalSim L1 / foundation] (a) paper_v2.cash_ledger save_cash_entry (repository.py:2028) is a bare INSERT with no ON CONFLICT and the DDL (trading_core_v2_schema.sql:878) has no unique on fill_id -> retried/replayed fills double-count cash and load_latest_cash reads a doubled cash_after. (b) The whole repository runs under autocommit (pg_pool.py:252/327) with zero transactions, so multi-write persistence (save_positions DELETE-then-INSERT; per-day snapshot copy in scheduler) has partial-write windows that corrupt cash/positions. FIX: add unique (run_id, fill_id) on paper_v2.cash_ledger + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (forward+rollback migration; dev can apply in validation environment; prod applied by user after merge); add an explicit transactional persistence path (disable autocommit / txn context) so each logical unit (one tick / one day snapshot copy) commits atomically incl. the bar-cursor advance. DDL CHANGE: include forward+rollback migration; do not apply to prod. MiniQMT path untouched.
